description: The compat suite's two-player stage (tools/compat/tacompat.py): the joining peer's half, applied on that peer, where owner 0 is the local player. Thirty units meet the hosting peer's (scenarios/compat-mp-host.json) in the middle of Two Continents, so both peers send each other creates, moves and hits within the stage's thirty seconds. Stock types only: every mod the suite runs has them. The commanders stay (clear_existing false).
